ideas.title: Uncovering Health Care Fraud in Southern California
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of health care fraud in Southern California, including the types of schemes, the entities involved, and the impact on patients and taxpayers.
questions: What are the most common types of health care fraud in Southern California?
How much money is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale issue and hold those responsible accountable. By analyzing data and public records, we can uncover the scope of the problem and identify patterns and connections between entities.
